name: Episodic Memories Generation and Evaluation Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' episodic memory capabilities, focusing on recall and episodic reasoning tasks involving temporal and spatial contexts, entities, and detailed event descriptions.
reputation: A niche research benchmark for episodic memory and recall in LLMs, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on episodic memory tasks with complex spatio-temporal relationships; evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs and reveals significant challenges.
